summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $1B+ accumulations in SPX 7000C contracts expiring in 2026 and 2027. While heavy put buying is visible in NDX and SNDK, the dominant conviction lies in massive SPX call sweeps, specifically the $840.3M and $676.5M bets on the 7000 strike. Persistent multi-day interest is concentrated in the SPX 7000C (exp 2026-12-18) with $2.86B flowing in over 4 sessions, signaling a structural long-term upward bias. Traders should watch for volatility in the SPX 8000P strikes and any follow-through in NVDA/AMD, as the massive SPX call premiums suggest institutions are aggressively hedging against tail risk while betting on a sustained rally.
